title.narrative: Democracy for All: Strengthening Inclusive Governance in Fiji (DASIG-Fiji)

description.narrative:
Overall Objective: to promote inclusive and accountable democratic governance in Fiji by supporting meaningful participation of all citizens, including marginalized groups, and cultivating civic engagement while ensuring government oversight and accountability.

Specific Objectives:

-  Increased citizen participation in policy-making processes, with marginalized groups included, through community education workshops, policy dialogue sessions, and public consultations.

-     Strengthened capacities of civil society organizations (CSOs) and media for government oversight and accountability, demonstrated through enhanced skills and knowledge acquired from capacity building training and media literacy programs.

Produced evidence-based recommendations for policy reform on democracy, human rights, governance, and social cohesion issues through research, and effectively disseminated findings to stakeholders and the general public for informed decision-making and advocacy.
